svg.title: Chatham VI: interpretive SVG study
svg.desc: Two joined monochrome panels forming an inverted L. Approximate geometry, standardized vivid screen palette, transparent background. Panel ratios estimated from the book cover; total aspect follows published dimensions.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.moma.org/d/pdfs/W1siZiIsIjIwMTgvMDYvMTMvOGlvazUweWl5aF9LZWxseV9DaGF0aGFtX1BSRVZJRVcxLnBkZiJdXQ/Kelly_Chatham_PREVIEW1.pdf?sha=cc613fbfe3ec18ec; reviewed 2026-10-26; interpretive reconstruction, not a facsimile.
